<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 20pt">RESEARCH <SUP>2.0</SUP></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 20pt"></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 20pt">Technology Industry Research &amp; Advisory</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 16pt">Additional Business Development Support Services Amendment to:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 16pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 16pt">Agreement Name: Viral Genetics/VG Energy</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 16pt">Client Viral Genetics</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 16pt">Dated 12/12/11</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 4 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->4<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 24pt">Amendment Description</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 24pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">This amendment allows Research 2.0 (R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">)
to engage with potential business partners or sources of capital and make introductions when there is a fit.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">In exchange for these services R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">
is eligible to receive compensation on completed deals and transactions per this amendment. This compensation is only for transactions
in which R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt"> has played a role.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">
activities shall be limited to making introductions to qualified potential business partners and investors. R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2
</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">will not be involved in structuring any transaction, nor induce prospective partners or investors
to take specific actions. R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt"> shall not play a role whatsoever
in negotiating or effecting transactions. R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt"> may not
receive payments for introductions from broker/dealer organizations.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt"></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 14pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 5 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->5<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 24pt">Qualification and Duration</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">
will communicate regularly as to which targets are being approached. Client has the ability to &ldquo;wave off&rdquo; a prospect.
In these cases R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt"> will make no further efforts nor qualify
for any compensation for a transaction from that source.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">In cases where the value of a deal or transaction is not straightforward both
the Client and R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt"> will create an estimate of the approximate
expected value. The R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt"> fee will based on an average of
these two estimates. If the Client objects to this R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">
agrees to be bound to the outcome a professionally recognized third party arbitration process. These services are to be paid for
by the Client.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">Unless increased in writing by the Client total cumulative fees due to R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2
</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">shall not exceed $500,000.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">If a qualifying transaction closes within 18 months of the termination of the
R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt"> / Client Agreement R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2
</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">would still be entitled to compensation.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 6 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->6<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>

    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 24pt">Compensation Terms</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">When a qualifying transaction occurs R</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">2
</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">will apply the following schedule to determine an amount to invoice:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">A. &lt;=$1M value: 7% of the amount</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">B. Up to $2M value: - The above (A) plus 5% of the portion
between $1M and $2M</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">C. &gt; 42M value - The above (B) plus 3% of the portion above
$2M</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">Transactions may include anything including sales, distribution
agreements, licensing deals, capital infusions and M&amp;A.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">In cases where a transaction value isn&rsquo;t known, will vary or
is governed by a contract period the compensation amount will be computed semi-annually and invoices based on cumulative
value.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">Invoices are due and payable when related monies are received
by the Client.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 12pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
